13586-poems.title: Poems
13586-poems.creator: Samuel Rogers
13586-poems.description: A book by Samuel Rogers. The Poem begins with the description of an obscure village, and of the pleasing melancholy which it excites on being revisited after a long absence. This mixed sensation is an effect of the Memory. From an effect we naturally ascend to the cause; and the subject proposed is then unfolded with an investigation of the nature and leading principles of this faculty.

arxiv-2112-01740.title: AirDet: Few-Shot Detection without Fine-tuning for Autonomous Exploration
arxiv-2112-01740.creator: Bowen Li, Chen Wang, Pranay Reddy, Seungchan Kim, Sebastian Scherer
arxiv-2112-01740.description: Abstract Few-shot object detection has attracted increasing attention and rapidly progressed in recent years. However, the requirement of an exhaustive offline fine-tuning stage in existing methods is time-consuming and significantly hinders their usage in online applications such as autonomous exploration of low-power robots.

arxiv-2210-00900.title: Curvature Inheritance Symmetry on M-Projectively Flat Spacetimes
arxiv-2210-00900.creator: Absos Ali Shaikh 1 , Musavvir Ali 2 , Mohammad Salman 3 and Füsun Özen Zengin 4
arxiv-2210-00900.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Absos Ali Shaikh 1 , Musavvir Ali 2 , Mohammad Salman 3 and Füsun Özen Zengin 4. The paper aims to investigate curvature inheritance symmetry in M-projectively flat spacetimes. It is shown that the curvature inheritance symmetry in M-projectively flat spacetime is a conformal motion.

arxiv-2301-08657.title: Certificates for Probabilistic Pushdown Automata via Optimistic Value Iteration Thanks: This work is supported by the DFG research training group 2236 UnRAVeL, the ERC advanced research grant 787914 FRAPPANT, and the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under the Marie Skł
arxiv-2301-08657.creator: Tobias Winkler ✉ {}^{\text{{\char 12\relax}}}, Joost-Pieter Katoen
arxiv-2301-08657.description: Abstract Probabilistic pushdown automata (pPDA) are a standard model for discrete probabilistic programs with procedures and recursion. In pPDA, many quantitative properties are characterized as least fixpoints of polynomial equation systems. In this paper, we study the problem of certifying that these quantities lie within certain bounds.

arxiv-2306-06995.title: How robust accuracy suffers from certified training with convex relaxations
arxiv-2306-06995.creator: Piersilvio De Bartolomeis 1, Jacob Clarysse 1, Amartya Sanyal 2, Fanny Yang 1
arxiv-2306-06995.description: Abstract Adversarial attacks pose significant threats to deploying state-of-the-art classifiers in safety-critical applications. Two classes of methods have emerged to address this issue: empirical defences and certified defences. Although certified defences come with robustness guarantees, empirical defences such as adversarial training enjoy much higher popularity among practitioners.

arxiv-2401-02322.title: Properties of Voids and Void Galaxies in the TNG300 Simulation
arxiv-2401-02322.creator: Olivia Curtis, Bryanne McDonough, Tereasa G. Brainerd
arxiv-2401-02322.description: Abstract We investigate the properties of voids and void galaxies in the TNG300 simulation. Using a luminous galaxy catalog and a spherical void finding algorithm, we identify 5,078 voids at redshift z = 0 z=0 . The voids cover 83% of the simulation volume and have a median radius of 4.4 ​ h − 1 ​ Mpc 4.4h^{-1}\rm{Mpc} .

arxiv-2407-00494.title: Graph Neural Networks Gone Hogwild
arxiv-2407-00494.creator: Olga Solodova, Nick Richardson, Deniz Oktay, Ryan P. Adams
arxiv-2407-00494.description: Abstract Graph neural networks (GNNs) appear to be powerful tools to learn state representations for agents in distributed, decentralized multi-agent systems, but generate catastrophically incorrect predictions when nodes update asynchronously during inference. This failure under asynchrony effectively excludes these architectures from many potential applications where synchrony is difficult or impossible to enforce, e.g., robotic swarms or sensor networks.

arxiv-2412-07260.title: DFREC: DeepFake Identity Recovery Based on Identity-aware Masked Autoencoder
arxiv-2412-07260.creator: Peipeng Yu, Hui Gao, Jianwei Fei, Zhitao Huang, Zhihua Xia, Chip-Hong Chang
arxiv-2412-07260.description: Abstract Recent advances in deepfake forensics have primarily focused on improving the classification accuracy and generalization performance. Despite enormous progress in detection accuracy across a wide variety of forgery algorithms, existing algorithms lack intuitive interpretability and identity traceability to help with forensic investigation. In this paper, we introduce a novel DeepFake Identity Recovery scheme (DFREC) to fill this gap.

arxiv-2503-07968.title: LabelCoRank: Revolutionizing Long Tail Multi-Label Classification with Co-Occurrence Reranking
arxiv-2503-07968.creator: Yan Yan, Junyuan Liu, Bo-Wen Zhang
arxiv-2503-07968.description: Abstract Motivation: Despite recent advancements in semantic representation driven by pre-trained and large-scale language models, addressing long tail challenges in multi-label text classification remains a significant issue. Long tail challenges have persistently posed difficulties in accurately classifying less frequent labels. Current approaches often focus on improving text semantics while neglecting the crucial role of label relationships.

arxiv-2506-17425.title: Trans 2 -CBCT: A Dual-Transformer Framework for Sparse-View CBCT Reconstruction
arxiv-2506-17425.creator: Minmin Yang, Huantao Ren, Senem Velipasalar
arxiv-2506-17425.description: Abstract Cone‑beam computed tomography (CBCT) using only a handful of X-ray projection views offers the potential for significantly reduced radiation dose and faster scans. However, such extreme angular under-sampling, typically limited to six to ten views, introduces severe streak artifacts and results in large gaps in spatial coverage.

pmc-11297267.title: Quantum advantage and stability to errors in analogue quantum simulators
pmc-11297267.creator: Rahul Trivedi, Adrian Franco Rubio, J Ignacio Cirac
pmc-11297267.description: Several quantum hardware platforms, while being unable to perform fully fault-tolerant quantum computation, can still be operated as analogue quantum simulators for addressing many-body problems. However, due to the presence of errors, it is not clear to what extent those devices can provide us with an advantage with respect to classical computers.

pmc-11432149.title: Characterization of Neutrophil Functional Responses to SARS-CoV-2 Infection in a Translational Feline Model for COVID-19
pmc-11432149.creator: Sachithra Gunasekara, Miruthula Tamil Selvan, Chelsea L Murphy, Shoroq Shatnawi, Shannon Cowan, Sunil More, Jerry Ritchey, Craig A Miller, Jennifer M Rudd, Marta De Angelis
pmc-11432149.description: There is a complex interplay between viral infection and host innate immune response regarding disease severity and outcomes. Neutrophil hyperactivation, including excessive release of neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs), is linked to exacerbated disease in acute COVID-19, notably in hospitalized patients. Delineating protective versus detrimental neutrophil responses is essential to developing targeted COVID-19 therapies and relies on high-quality translational animal models.

pmc-11494109.title: Multi-parametric thrombus profiling microfluidics detects intensified biomechanical thrombogenesis associated with hypertension and aging
pmc-11494109.creator: Misbahud Din, Souvik Paul, Sana Ullah, Haoyi Yang, Rong-Guang Xu, Nurul Aisha Zainal Abidin, Allan Sun, Yiyao Catherine Chen, Rui Gao, Bari Chowdhury, Fangyuan Zhou, Stephenie Rogers, Mariel Miller, Atreyee Biswas, Liang Hu, Zhichao Fan, Christopher Zahner, Jing Fan, Zi Chen, Megan Berman, Lingzhou
pmc-11494109.description: Arterial thrombosis is a leading cause of death and disability worldwide with no effective bioassay for clinical prediction. As a symbolic feature of arterial thrombosis, severe stenosis in the blood vessel creates a high-shear, high-gradient flow environment that facilitates platelet aggregation towards vessel occlusion.

pmc-11675216.title: Evaluation of a Pilot College Student-Based Physical Activity Implementation Strategy in a Rural Middle School
pmc-11675216.creator: Megan M. Kwaiser, Andrew M. Medellin, Janette M. Watkins, Janelle M. Goss, James M. Hobson, Vanessa M. Martinez Kercher, Kyle A. Kercher
pmc-11675216.description: Background: Physical inactivity in the U.S. poses a significant risk of developing chronic health factors associated with cardiovascular disease. Children from rural communities are especially vulnerable to inactivity. The Hoosier Sport program aims to address this by working to increase physical activity in 6th and 7th grade students in a rural Indiana middle school.

pmc-12495758.title: Spectator medicine in the men’s international Ice Hockey World Championships in 2022 and 2023
pmc-12495758.creator: Ville Bister, Kerttu J. Toivo, Timo H. Hänninen, Collins Hart, Markku P. Tuominen
pmc-12495758.description: IntroductionSports events attract large crowds, necessitating the provision of medical services. Medical issues at these events can include acute injuries, such as falls or incidents related to the sport being played, as well as the worsening of pre-existing health conditions.

pmc-12677183.title: Dyadic coping and fear of cancer progression among patients with hepatocellular carcinoma and their spouses in China: An actor–partner interdependence model
pmc-12677183.creator: Rukang Hu, Huijuan Lu, Jingxian Yu, Zheng Zhu
pmc-12677183.description: ObjectiveThis study examined the relationship between dyadic coping and fear of cancer progression (FoP) in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and their spouses to provide insights into their interrelations and inform future couple-based practice.MethodsThis cross-sectional study included 305 HCC patients and their spousal dyads.

pmc-13395004.title: Integrated PANoptosis Profiling Identifies Immunosuppressive Subtypes and a Prognostic Signature With Functional Validation of MLKL in Glioblastoma
pmc-13395004.creator: Langfei Tian, Minghui Zhao, Yuanbo Hu, Kaiyue Wang, Haiguang Liu, Zetong Bai, Kebin Zheng
pmc-13395004.description: ObjectiveThe prognosis of glioblastoma (GBM) remains highly unfavorable, largely due to high tumor heterogeneity and an immunosuppressive microenvironment. However, the functional role of PANoptosis in this context is poorly understood.MethodsPatients were stratified via K‐means clustering. A risk score model was constructed using prognosis‐associated genes identified by Cox regression and validated in independent cohorts.

pmc-13581807.title: Brain metastasis secondary to primary vaginal clear cell adenocarcinoma not associated with diethylstilbestrol: a case report and a review of the literature
pmc-13581807.creator: Esther Anyimadu Buckson, Obi Emereole, John Richard Ouma
pmc-13581807.description: BackgroundCases of primary clear cell adenocarcinoma of the vagina (PCCAV) are infrequently encountered and account for only 5%–10% of all primary vaginal cancers 1. The most common associated risk factor for developing PCCAV is in utero exposure to diethylstilbestrol (DES). Patients with non-DES-related PCCAV are even scarcer and usually have a worse prognosis.
